model.description: Experimental DaSiWa MiniMax H3 Hybrid v3 non-distilled checkpoint. Generate from text, start/end/timed frames, or a Control Video. Shares one 21 GB INT8 checkpoint with its References companion.
model.selector_help:
DASIWA H3 HYBRID V3 — FRAMES (EXPERIMENTAL)
Generate from text, start/end/timed frames, or a Control Video. Non-distilled: start at 25 Euler steps. Optional H3 accelerators use the Ref2VA AdaLN basis.
Frames and References share one pinned 21 GB pruned INT8 ConvRot checkpoint, with synchronized audio. Downloads come directly from the creator on Civitai and use the key in Settings > Services.
